en: Black‑and‑white street scene in a small European town, likely early 20th century. Cobblestone road lined with two‑storey houses and shops with gabled roofs. A horse‑drawn cart loaded with barrels moves down the middle of the street; a man drives it while children push handcarts nearby. Several pedestrians walk in the distance. Telegraph poles line the street. On the right is a more ornate corner building with a clock sign projecting above a shop entrance, its facade partly covered with climbing plants. There is some faint shop signage on buildings but it is not fully legible.
